name: Infinite Picnic Blanket
description: A checkered picnic blanket stretching across hills into a miniature world of tiny picnics.
prompt: A single whimsical landscape: an endless red-and-white checkered picnic blanket rolling over green hills into the horizon, dotted with tiny picnic scenes, baskets, sandwiches, kites, and miniature people, giant trees and soft clouds, warm afternoon light, playful scale, detailed and inviting, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: The picnic that kept going. 🧺🌄
